greek_vs_coptic_distinction.epsilon_note: word where ⲩ sounds 'y' is Greek (Ⲗⲩⲭⲛⲓⲁ, Ⲩⲓⲟⲥ)
exceptions: ϩ used before Greek words for rough breathing (ϩⲱⲇⲏ)
ϯ used as feminine definite article before Greek nouns (ϯϩⲱⲇⲏ)
pronunciation_effects: ⲥ = z in Greek-origin words (Ⲕⲟⲥⲙⲟⲥ), s in Coptic (Ⲥⲙⲩⲣⲛⲁ)
ⲭ = kh or sh in Greek words (Ⲗⲩⲭⲛⲓⲁ kh, Ⲡⲣⲟⲥⲉⲩⲭⲏ sh)
